headline: NO PLAN: block over, today is unscheduled. Treat as amber until HRV and sleep sync
summary: The Valtellina block ended with the race on 7 Nov: 22.1km, 825m D+, 134min, avg HR 172, load 212, RPE 9. Nothing is planned from 8 Nov onward, so there's no session to grade or gate today. Today's readiness is incomplete. RHR is 49 (fine), but HRV and sleep haven't synced. Yesterday was amber: HRV 48, down 20 from 68 on the 13th, with RHR 49 and sleep 7.5h. So I can't call today green. Since the race: easy runs on 9 and 10 Nov (loads 20 and 30), then 24.9km / 572m D+ / 138min on 11 Nov (load 138, avg HR 149, RPE 7, feel 4 = Poor), four days after a race effort. The two mornings after that run were the low point: HRV 48 then 44, sleep 5.3h then 5.8h. No activity logged for 12-14 Nov. CTL has gone from 57.4 on race day to 51.4, ATL is 35.5 and TSB is about +16, so you're fully recovered and losing fitness. If HRV syncs at 55+ with sleep over 6h: 50-60min easy run, Z2 142-155bpm, with a hard cap at 155. A Z2 spin at 134-147bpm also works if you have a bike. If HRV is under 55 or sleep is under 6h: 30-40min Z1, at or below 141bpm, or rest.
flags: The block is finished and the plan has no weeks after 8 Nov. The next race and a new block (race, baseline, weeks) need to be set up in the coaching chat. The daily coach can't do this.
11 Nov: 138min long run 4 days after the race, with feel 4 (Poor). HRV fell to 44-48 for the next two mornings. That's the long-day overreach pattern again.
CTL 57.4 -> 51.4 in 8 days with nothing logged for 12-14 Nov. A short recovery break is fine, but every extra empty day costs fitness for the next block.
